issues.description: The template's simulate_msd_two_rounds stub creates a Stim circuit using stim.Circuit(p) (passing a parameter), while the rest of the code (and the solution) construct Stim circuits with no arguments via stim.Circuit(). This constructor-parameter usage is inconsistent and will confuse students about the correct way to create a Circuit and may cause errors when running or extending the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the solution and other code by constructing the circuit without arguments (use stim.Circuit()). Remove the stray parameter in the template (change stim.Circuit(p) to stim.Circuit()), or add a clear comment in the problem statement explaining the intended constructor usage if a non-default constructor is required.
